body: <sf-chart-bar id="c" label="Продажи по городам, 2026" x="city" y="q1,q2" y-format="integer"></sf-chart-bar>
<sf-chart-bar id="s" label="Заказы по каналам" x="month" y="web,shop,partners" stack="normalized"></sf-chart-bar>
<sf-chart-bar id="h" label="Рейтинг" x="city" y="q1" orientation="horizontal" sort="descending"></sf-chart-bar>
<sf-chart-bar id="l" label="Выручка и маржа" x="q" y="revenue,margin" lines="margin" line-axis="own" line-format="percent" y-format="integer" table="hidden"></sf-chart-bar>
<sf-chart-bar id="b" label="Время доставки заказов" x="hours" bin="auto" x-label="Часов" y-label="Заказов" y-format="integer"></sf-chart-bar>

checks.title: a figure named by its label; the plot is one group described by a summary; a gap draws no bar
checks.covers: accessibility (role figure, name label), settings.items, settings.summary

steps.script: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#c'); c.names = {"q1": "I квартал", "q2": "II квартал"}; c.items = [{"city": "Москва", "q1": 420, "q2": 465}, {"city": "Санкт-Петербург", "q1": 310, "q2": 298}, {"city": "Казань", "q1": 180, "q2": 214}, {"city": "Новосибирск", "q1": 150, "q2": 171}, {"city": "Екатеринбург", "q1": 164, "q2": 159}, {"city": "Нижний Новгород", "q1": 120, "q2": null}]; const s = document.querySelector('#s'); s.names = {"web": "Сайт", "shop": "Магазин", "partners": "Партнёры"}; s.items = [{"month": "2026-07", "web": 42, "shop": 30, "partners": 12}, {"month": "2026-08", "web": 45, "shop": 28, "partners": 15}, {"month": "2026-09", "web": 51, "shop": 26, "partners": 14}, {"month": "2026-10", "web": 55, "shop": 25, "partners": 18}, {"month": "2026-11", "web": 58, "shop": 24, "partners": 20}, {"month": "2026-12", "web": 66, "shop": 29, "partners": 22}]; const h = document.querySelector('#h'); h.items = [{"city": "Москва", "q1": 420, "q2": 465}, {"city": "Санкт-Петербург", "q1": 310, "q2": 298}, {"city": "Казань", "q1": 180, "q2": 214}, {"city": "Новосибирск", "q1": 150, "q2": 171}, {"city": "Екатеринбург", "q1": 164, "q2": 159}, {"city": "Нижний Новгород", "q1": 120, "q2": null}]; return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('#c figure'); const s = document.querySelector('#c svg[role=group]'); const d = document.getElementById(s.getAttribute('aria-describedby')); return f && document.getElementById(f.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).textContent.trim() === 'Продажи по городам, 2026' && s.getAttribute('aria-roledescription') === 'диаграмма' && /Категорий: 6\./u.test(d.textContent) && /I квартал: наибольшее 420 \(Москва\)/u.test(d.textContent) && document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-chart-bar-bar').length === 11; })()

steps.check: (() => { const bars = [...document.querySelectorAll('#s .sf-chart-bar-series')].map((g) => g.querySelector('.sf-chart-bar-bar')); const total = bars.reduce((sum, bar) => sum + Number(bar.getAttribute('height')), 0); const plot = document.querySelector('#s .sf-chart-bar-baseline'); return Math.abs(total - (Number(plot.getAttribute('y1')) - Number(bars[2].getAttribute('y')))) <= 2 && /^июль 2026 г\.?, Сайт: 50 ?% \(42\)$/u.test(document.querySelector('#s [aria-live]').textContent.trim().replace(/\u00a0/gu, ' ')); })()

checks.title: a series named in lines is a line with points over the bars, on its own scale with its own format; the cursor walks onto it and select carries it

steps.script: (() => { const l = document.querySelector('#l'); l.names = {"revenue": "Выручка", "margin": "Маржа"}; l.items = [{"q": "I кв.", "revenue": 1200, "margin": 0.18}, {"q": "II кв.", "revenue": 1350, "margin": 0.21}, {"q": "III кв.", "revenue": 1280, "margin": 0.17}, {"q": "IV кв.", "revenue": 1500, "margin": 0.24}]; return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const l = document.querySelector('#l'); const d = document.getElementById(l.querySelector('svg[role=group]').getAttribute('aria-describedby')).textContent.replace(/\u00a0/gu, ' '); const ticks = [...l.querySelectorAll('.sf-chart-bar-tick--line')].map((one) => one.textContent); return l.querySelectorAll('.sf-chart-bar-line').length === 1 && l.querySelectorAll('.sf-chart-bar-bar').length === 4 && ticks.length > 1 && ticks.every((one) => /%$/u.test(one)) && /Линией: Маржа\./u.test(d) && /Маржа: наибольшее 24 ?% \(IV кв\.\)/u.test(d) && [...l.querySelectorAll('.sf-chart-bar-sr table td')].some((one) => /^18 ?%$/u.test(one.textContent.trim().replace(/\u00a0/gu, ' '))); })()

steps.script: (() => { window.__lineChosen = null; document.querySelector('#l').addEventListener('sf-chart-bar-select', (event) => { window.__lineChosen = event.detail; }); document.querySelector('#l svg[role=group]').focus(); return true; })()

checks.title: with bin the rows are cut into intervals of one round width: one touching bar per interval, the axis marked at the edges and the counts on whole steps, the summary says the count, the range, the intervals and the median, and the cursor says each interval's count

steps.check: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#b svg[role=group]'); const d = document.getElementById(s.getAttribute('aria-describedby')).textContent.replace(/\u00a0|\u202f/gu, ' '); const bars = [...document.querySelectorAll('#b .sf-chart-bar-bar')].map((r) => [Number(r.getAttribute('x')), Number(r.getAttribute('width'))]); const ticks = [...document.querySelectorAll('#b .sf-chart-bar-tick--x')].map((t) => t.textContent); const values = [...document.querySelectorAll('#b .sf-chart-bar-tick:not(.sf-chart-bar-tick--x)')].map((t) => t.textContent); return /^Значений: 30, от 5 до 61; интервалов: 7, шириной 10\. Количество: медиана 21,5, больше всего — 10 – 20 \(10\)\.$/u.test(d) && bars.length === 7 && bars.every(([x, w], i) => i === 0 || Math.abs(bars[i - 1][0] + bars[i - 1][1] - x) < 0.2) && ticks.join('|') === '0|10|20|30|40|50|60|70' && values.length >= 3 && values.every((t) => /^\d+$/u.test(t)); })()
